fixed_factors.holdout_reuse_status: same geography exposed by H35-01 through H35-04; exploratory only

rationale.max_scale_m: 200 to 1200 m Gaussian Hessian scales on 100 m input grid; screening range only
rationale.linearity_power: 0.5 to 3 controls preference for elongated rather than point-like curvature; not calibrated
rationale.distance_weight: 0 to 1 interpolates seismic-density ridge and inverse earthquake-distance trough evidence
rationale.prediction_fraction: 0.4% to 1.2% of eligible pixels; comparator arms matched at actual emissions
rationale.feature_layers: earthquake intensity/density and distance bands from the owner-mirror band descriptions; official-file provenance unverified
rationale.correlation_caveat: density and distance surfaces may be derived from correlated catalog products and are not independent evidence
rationale.provenance: existing competition features/labels are a public owner-maintained mirror, not organizer-authenticated
